notes_for_editor: Only the tnlandforms.us list gives this tower any facts (name, county, elevation, coordinates). Its notes column says Ron, and the page has no key for that. The list has no status, tag or register number for it. No NHLR, FFLOS, Forest Lookouts or photo source in the cache matched. Two web searches found no history of the tower. A cached Wikipedia page for Monroe County, Georgia, lists a place called Franklinton as well; the list's coordinates put this tower in Bibb County, so the story follows the list. Needs a records check (Georgia Forestry Commission, Macon-Bibb archives) before a longer story.
